settlement_source: Rockstar Games, Take-Two Interactive, official GTA 6 credits, in-game radio track listings, verified gameplay footage from major gaming outlets (IGN, GameSpot, Polygon, Kotaku, PC Gamer, Game Informer, Eurogamer, The Verge), official artist/label press releases (GTASONGS terms). Series metadata lists only Kotaku and Rockstar.
settlement_variable: Whether a specific song (title+artist, original studio recording) is playable on at least one in-game radio station in the launch version of GTA VI (day-one patch included, North American release, any major platform)
trading_close_vs_settlement: Latest expiration = 30 days after official North American release date of GTA VI; moves earlier once outcome determined (Rule 7.2; can_close_early=1). API close_time varies per market (2030-01-01 placeholder for some; 2026-11-19 for Blinding Lights). Settlement no later than day after expiration unless under review; timer 1800s.
early_close_or_void_clauses: Market Outcome Review (Rule 6.3(d)) at sole discretion
Undeterminable value -> Kalshi determines payouts per 6.3(b)
Behaviour if game not released before close_time: unknown
title_vs_rules_divergences: Event title 'What songs will be on GTA 6' vs actual per-song contract 'playable on radio at launch'
Excludes songs only in cutscenes/missions/menus/trailers, post-launch DLC/updates, custom stations, collector-edition exclusives
Covers/remixes/live versions do not count; censored versions count if recognizable
Day-one patch counts; later additions don't
close_time (e.g. 2030-01-01) not tied to actual release date; mixed earlier close_times (2026-11-19) with unexplained reason
toxicity_flags: Insider risk: Rockstar/Take-Two/label/artist staff hold MNPI (Source Agency employees prohibited)
Official track-list announcements are discrete jump events
Long-dated multi-year capital lock; release date uncertain
notes: Rules do not say individual song markets close early before launch; the 2026-11-19 close for Blinding Lights is unexplained. Whether Rockstar has confirmed any launch songs is unknown.
